clean_structure: clean a PDB structure by dropping missing sequences, non-standard atoms, waters, hydrogens, leaving atoms, and bad bonds
create_empty_output_struc_and_layout: create a zero-coordinate structure and flat atom layout from all physical residues of a PDB structure
get_leaving_atom_mask: compute a boolean mask identifying leaving atoms to drop for a given residue in a structure
review_clean_structure: review the clean_structure function to understand how it filters waters, hydrogens, and leaving atoms from a PDB
refactor_clean_structure: refactor the clean_structure function to add a new filter option for dropping specific residue types
